text:
maria.sales: Quick thread 3 MerchantCorp asks for BYOK POC with a short rotation demo + clear quote line for HSM ops. Can we scope?

leo.solutions: Do they want HSM-originated CMK (non-exportable) or import-wrapped keys? Also ask if they require an on-site key ceremony.

sam.engineer: We can do both. Recommendation for demo: HSM-originated CMK, 2-of-3 custodians, single-region. Perf overhead ~5ms for encrypt RPC. Rotation dry-run during low traffic window OK.

eva.security: Requirements: attestation bundle (vendor cert + firmware digest), signed custodian acknowledgements, and audit export to customer SIEM for 90 days. Rotation cadence: customer-requested acceptable; recommend default 90d. No plaintext key export.

tara.ps: Quote items: HSM-POC-5D rental, TECH-ON-SITE-DAY if they want local custodians, BYOK-ONBOARD-FEE, optional ESCROW-ADDENDUM. I'll draft numbers.

ops-bot: Calendar: POC kickoff scheduled Thu 09:30 AM ET (organizer: maria.sales)

maria.sales: Action items: @leo.solutions send short runbook + custodian checklist, @eva.security attach attestation template, @tara.ps draft quote lines. I'll send SOW after we confirm.

leo.solutions: Will post runbook & checklist by EOD (includes network preflight, cert names, custodian ID fields).

eva.security: Will upload attestation template and minimal legal wording for BYOK appendix shortly.

tara.ps: Draft attached to SOW draft in shared drive.

maria.sales: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" keeping this thread as canonical for MerchantCorp POC.
